summary.text: Christy Armendariz is a member of the Nebraska Legislature (Unicameral) representing District 18, serving since 2022. Her committee assignments are Appropriations and Committee on Committees.

paragraphs.text: According to her legislative biography, Armendariz was born December 10, 1966, in Omaha.
She graduated from the University of Nebraska at Omaha with a B.S. in business administration in 2009 and from Nebraska Methodist College with an M.B.A. in 2021.
Her biography lists work as a strategic sourcing specialist and enterprise sales professional, and membership in St. Elizabeth Ann Seton Catholic Church.
It lists her as married to Ralph since December 24, 1991, with three children.
